title: Bhutan Second Nationally Determined Contribution
methodology: Government NDC describing national climate context, institutions, and planned mitigation and adaptation actions.
limitations: Policy submission; planned actions are not evaluated outcomes, and the inspected passages do not quantify local hazard exposure.

title: Assessment of Climate-Induced Loss and Damage in Bhutan
temporal_coverage: Assessment published in 2026; includes a documented October 2025 extreme-weather event.
methodology: Review of secondary documents, key-informant group interviews, stakeholder workshop, and field visits.
limitations: The report notes limited primary datasets and dispersed institutional knowledge; the inspected 2025 event passage reports impacts but does not attribute the event to climate change.

title: Adaptation, Climate Resilience, and Diversification Key to Creating Jobs, Accelerating Growth in Bhutan
temporal_coverage: World Bank publication page dated 2025; reports modeled risks through 2050.
methodology: Official World Bank release summarizing findings and recommendations from its Bhutan Country Climate and Development Report.
limitations: The press-release summary does not provide underlying model specifications; the qualitative hotter-and-drier scenario is not assigned a named pathway.
